title: Q-GATE-ACTIONS-BYPASS: let GitHub enforce checks on main without blocking the fleet's own pushes
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the tick Worker applier (`seed/worker/src/auth/rulesets.js`) is refused by GitHub, HTTP 422: "Actor GitHub Actions integration must be part of the ruleset source or owner organization" (credential_events, 2026-11-18T08:20Z). The Actions app (15368) cannot be a bypass actor, so a rule that requires `checks` on main would also refuse the workflow-token pushes of regen-generated, lane, deploy-record and watchdog.
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation mergeaudit --check
**Status:** open

Plan: move those pushes onto a bypass-capable identity or to pull requests, then drop the 15368 bypass entry from `github/org-settings.json` and `RULESETS`; the applier already exempts the Worker's own app from its stored install id. Until then the rule stays unapplied (the 422 is the safe state) and MERGE-AUDIT-1 (#622) audits direct merges after the fact. Do not remove the 15368 entry alone: the rule would be accepted and the fleet's write-backs to main would stop.

**Closing probe:** `GET /repos/ultrastable/ultrastable/rulesets` lists `main-requires-checks` active and a regen-generated push to main still lands.
